text:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for eu-west-2 gateway starting ~18:45 UTC. Error rate 18% (baseline ~0.4%). Paging oncall @sarah. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/gw-eu-west2

sarah (oncall): Ack, seeing it. Jumping in.

sarah (oncall): @mike SRE you around? Lots of 502/504s coming through the gateway.

mike SRE: I'm here. Pulling logs + routing metrics now. Which pools are spiking?

sarah (oncall): Quick sample from gateway logs:
```
[18:46:12] gw-prod eu-west-2 502 "upstream reset" path=/v1/generate client=svc-frontend
[18:46:14] gw-prod eu-west-2 504 "upstream timeout" path=/v1/stream client=svc-frontend
```

mike SRE: looks like backend pool "mlworker-eu-west-2" showing connection resets and high latency. Upstream_kv_timeouts also elevated.

anya infra: I'll pre-warm eu-west-1 pool and spin extra instances. If we need fallback we can steer traffic to eu-west-1.

jason product: Any customer-facing impact numbers? Support?

emma support: We're seeing ~40 new support hits in last 10m mentioning timeouts. Several customers reporting degraded synth latency. Putting up a banner: "Intermittent API errors in EU region; engineers investigating."

grafana-bot: ALERT: gateway_errors_eu_west2 > 15% for 5m. upstream_kv_timeouts high.

mike SRE: Starting a controlled traffic steer as short mitigation. Plan: 1) shift 30% traffic to eu-west-1 2) investigate redis/kv saturation and failover if needed 3) increase autoscale on eu-west-1.

sarah (oncall): Executing step 1 now.

mike SRE: Command run:
```
./rwctl route shift --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --percent 30 --dry-run=false
```

sarah (oncall): 30% shifted. Monitoring... error rate in eu-west-2 dropped to ~12% in 2m. Not back to baseline yet.

mike SRE: Lowering gateway retry threshold to reduce overall tail:
```
kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gw --containers=gw GATEWAY_RETRIES=2
```

anya infra: Autoscale triggered in eu-west-1: +8 instances, +3 pre-warm. Load starting to stabilize on fallback region.

mike SRE: Diving deeper into backend: redis connection pool logs on mlworker show "pool exhausted" and lots of timeouts. Suspect connection saturation from long-running batches.

sarah (oncall): Any deploys that could have caused this?

jason product: No infra deploys scheduled. Telemetry shows a sudden spike in long-sequence generation requests from partner "Partner-X" starting 18:44.

emma support: Reaching out to Partner-X account team now to ask about any bulk jobs.

mike SRE: Proposed mitigation steps:
- Increase route shift up to 60% if stability continues.
- Trigger redis replica failover to offload writes.
- If necessary, apply temporary rate limit on heavy partner keys.

sarah (oncall): I'll escalate to infra for redis failover.

mike SRE: Initiating redis replica failover to eu-west-1.
```
redis-cli -h redis-eu-west-2 CLUSTER FAILOVER
```
(then rotate pool connection strings)

grafana-bot: metric update: gateway_error_rate eu-west-2 -> 3.6% after 60% traffic shift + redis failover. Latency returned near baseline.

emma support: Banner updated: "Issue mitigated; partial recovery underway. Investigations continue. ETA full recovery 30m."

jason product: Please notify sales/CS for any SLA concerns and prepare initial incident blurb for customers.

anya infra: Reverting temporary env tweaks once stable. Marking runbook steps executed: route_shift, redis_failover, autoscale.

mike SRE: Hypothesis: Partner-X sudden long-sequence burst consumed KV connections on mlworkers causing pool exhaustion -> downstream 5xx at gateway. Follow-ups: tuning pooling, batching guardrails, partner throttles, circuit-breaker tuning.

sarah (oncall): Keeping incident P1 while we validate full recovery and confirm no data loss. Preparing handoff to night oncall in ~2h.

sarah (oncall): Handoff snippet ready: summary, mitigation, current status, open actions (postmortem owner, partner follow-up, pooling changes).

noah (oncall-night): ack. I'll monitor overnight and pick up any regressions. Please leave runbook step IDs and links.

incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1187. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

mike SRE: Adding initial notes to incident doc. Root-cause hypothesis and mitigation timeline included.

sarah (oncall): Closing live coordination here. Monitoring continues. Will update thread if anything changes.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from mike SRE, :eyes: from jason product)
